knownDeficiencies.phase: generic vendored CCA with nonzero controller; unreachable in current guarded wrapper
knownDeficiencies.prerequisite: Deploy generic ContinuousClearingAuction with a nonzero controller returning a protocol fee larger than currencyRaised; auction graduated and checkpointed at END_BLOCK.
knownDeficiencies.trace: getProtocolFeeAmount returns controller-supplied uint256 unchanged. lbpInitializationParams computes checked currencyRaised-protocolFeeAmount; setting response to currencyRaised+1 produces arithmetic Panic(0x11). sweepCurrency clamps fee to currencyRaised before subtracting, so the two getters/settlement paths disagree.
knownDeficiencies.impact: Generic CCA initialization-parameter read and integrations depending on it cannot progress with oversized fee response. Current OmertaGuardedAuction hardcodes controller address(0), and ProtocolFeeLib returns zero in that case, making this defect unreachable there.
knownDeficiencies.disposition: The initialization read now clamps the fee to currencyRaised, matching sweepCurrency. The retained pre-fix regression failed with Panic(0x11); the final complete suite passed 1293 tests across 89 suites with zero failures or skips (seed 0x20261003, fuzz512, invariant128x128). Current guarded zero-controller behavior is covered separately. Upstream pin/hash is preserved alongside the local patch provenance.

diagnostics.description:
OmertaGuardedAuction._internalClaimTokens(uint256) (src/genesis-auction/OmertaGuardedAuction.sol#43-49) has external calls inside a loop: block.chainid != launchChainId || address(launchGate).codehash != launchGateCodeHash || ! launchGate.playerClaimsOpen() (src/genesis-auction/OmertaGuardedAuction.sol#46-47)
	Calls stack containing the loop:
		ContinuousClearingAuction.claimTokensBatch(address,uint256[])
diagnostics.rationale: Inherited claimTokensBatch loops caller-supplied bid IDs and the virtual _internalClaimTokens invokes immutable launchGate.playerClaimsOpen by view STATICCALL each time. No global protocol queue is consumed. Large/reverting batches revert only that transaction; claimTokens(singleId) remains independently reachable. Gate failure intentionally closes both paths; gate codehash/chain checks apply each invocation. src/genesis-auction/OmertaGuardedAuction.sol:43-49; vendor/cca/ContinuousClearingAuction.sol:604-645.
